edges.reason: msg.sender selects the stakes mapping entry processed in claimFromTraining.
msg.sender is the recipient of safeTransferFrom, so the caller encodes the callback target.
earnings are paid out to msg.sender through bgTransfer.
msg.sender controls whether the ownerOf ownership check is skipped when it equals golemsAndDragons.
block.timestamp drives reward and stat math, creating a timestamp dependency.
computed earnings value is forwarded to bgTransfer.
safeTransferFrom performs an external call back into the receiver before claimFromTraining finishes.
bgTransfer external call can reenter claimFromTraining while loop state is still being updated.
startTrainingTokens invokes transferFrom to pull the NFT.
claimFromTraining invokes addStats after each iteration.
unstake branch executes the totalTokensStaked decrement.
decrement writes to the totalTokensStaked state variable.
onlyOwner writes the golemsAndDragons address, a privileged state change.
onlyOwner writes the ancientGold address, a privileged state change.
msg.sender must equal the owner to pass the onlyOwner guard on upgrade authorization.
stakes mapping is read and mutated inside claimFromTraining.
stakeIndices is used to locate the stake slot inside claimFromTraining.
address_ parameter determines whose stake array is written in startTrainingTokens.
tokens array drives the loop of startTrainingTokens.
tokens array drives the loop of claimFromTraining.
unstake flag branches the effects inside claimFromTraining.
contract_ parameter is stored by setGolemsAndDragons.
contract_ parameter is stored by setAncientGold.
user parameter indexes the stakes mapping in getAllStakes.
accumulated earnings local is passed to bgTransfer.
stake.time from the memory Stake feeds the reward arithmetic.
actualHealthRate local feeds the health argument of addStats.
health local is passed to addStats.
attack local is passed to addStats.
defense local is passed to addStats.
agility local is passed to addStats.
balance local clamps the earnings amount sent to bgTransfer.
lastStake local is written back into the stakes mapping during swap-and-pop.
stakes mapping value is copied into the local Stake memory variable.
